authority: automation_optimizer is sole aggregate-ledger reconciler; durable per-role source-qualified artifacts/receipts remain execution authority

runs.observed_problem: A current evaluation receipt established that useful_output_gate can remain informational rather than control hard_pass/evaluate exit once coverage reaches 20, creating a second aggregate false-acceptance path after the already-known cross-record duplicate-effect gap.
runs.decision: Keep the same 14-role Phase-1 allocation and scheduler state, but make useful-output adequacy a root-level hard acceptance gate with a precommitted low-usefulness negative control and matched positive control. Do not transition to Phase 2.

rollback.condition: Only if useful-output gate itself is shown invalid due schema/transport error; preserve scheduler and all safety boundaries.

runs.exact_next_action: Require durable evaluation checker-v2 precommit/readback; duplicate-effect negative failure; >=20 opportunity useful_output_rate<0.80 negative failure; matched >=0.80 positive pass; then independently rederive aggregate gates and reconcile remaining neuroscience/novelty/primary/human cells.

history_policy: Earlier aggregate history is preserved by immutable optimizer receipts and previous_ledger_blob; this mutable ledger stores the latest reconciled run and exact predecessor pointer.
